description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 6

The red mage can go without eating or drinking for a number of days equal to his Charisma modifier before he must make Constitution checks to avoid nonlethal damage. Additionally, he can spend 8 hours studying his spells instead of sleeping. This confers the same benefit as an 8 hour rest, but he is awake the entire time.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Talents)
